messages:
rachel: Proposal: change default SIEM export retention for external partner buckets to 14 days (was 90). Rationale: reduce exposure window + lower storage costs. Need RBAC gating, KMS unwrap workflow, and legal exception flow. @tom @jorge please weigh in.

tom: 14d seems aggressive but reasonable for partner handoffs. We must ensure a quick extension path for ongoing investigations. Suggest default + easy "extend by X days" with approver audit.

jorge: On RBAC: propose roles `siem:export:request`, `siem:export:approve`, `siem:export:execute`. Only `execute` can call the KMS-unlock service; restrict to a small allowlist of machine accounts.

rachel: KMS plan: no raw CMK material in app. Use a KMS-proxy that accepts an approved request_id and returns a short-lived unwrap token (TTL 8m). Proxy enforces request_approved=true and checks request.retention_days <= 365. All decrypts must include EncryptionContext.request_id.

tom: CMK policy snippet idea: require `kms:EncryptionContext:request_id` AND `kms:GrantIsForExport` custom context. Deny if request.legal_hold == true. CloudTrail must log kms:RequestId and we should correlate that with request_id in SIEM.

jorge: Request template (minimal):
```
- request_id: auto
- requester: name/email
- scope: index patterns + time window
- justification: free text
- retention_days: default 14 (max 365 or special legal_hold)
- contains_pii: checkbox
- approver: auto-assigned security/legal
- kms_cmk: readonly
- bucket_path: generated
- audit_links: ticket/slack
```

rachel: UI UX: when contains_pii is checked, enforce DLP_scrub required and quarantined bucket path. Also require `data_category` selection (auth, payment, pii) so DLP rules auto-apply.

sec-bot: ticket created SEC-2026-9007 -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2026-9007 status: open

tom: CLI stub for triage team:
```
redwood-siem export create --scope "auth*:2026-03-10..2026-03-11" \ 
  --retention 14 --justification "partner triage" --requester rachel@redwood.ai
```

jorge: Important: for legal_hold requests, disable automatic KMS-unwrap. Require two approvers (security + legal) and manual exec. Record approver IDs in request metadata and surface immutability flag in audit.

rachel: Action items: 1) tom - draft CMK policy + CloudTrail query for decrypt correlation 2) jorge - PR for request schema + RBAC roles 3) rachel - update RFC and UX copy. Sync in sec sync tomorrow 9:30. :thumbsup:
